newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says Boeing must make concessions.
newsitem.headline: EU says Boeing must make concessions.

text.p: Boeing must make concessions to win European Union regulatory approval for its merger with McDonnell Douglas, Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said, reiterating that the EU would not give in to political pressure.
EU says Boeing must make concessions =2
Recalling that the Commission had strong competition concerns about the $14 billion merger, Van Miert said he was determined to pursue the investigation to the end.

"We try to go as far as possible regarding cooperation (with the United States), but it is clear that we must obtain remedies that meet our concerns," Van Miert told the European Parliament economic and monetary affairs committee.
"We are determined to pursue the proceedings until the end," he said.

Van Miert again denied suggestions that the Commission does not have the power to impose any conditions because the two companies are both located outside the EU. He noted that the United States itself had long claimed jurisdiction over non-U.S. deals, citing a merger between Swiss drug companies Sandoz SANZ.S and Ciba Geigy. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
